# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_PULLBACK_VWAP_RECLAIM_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A pullback to the 8‑EMA that finds support at VWAP, confirmed by RSI>50, signals a long‑side mean‑reversion bounce in an uptrending ribbon environment. This captures short-term mean reversion within a bullish trend structure, where the 8‑EMA/VWAP confluence acts as dynamic support and RSI>50 filters for underlying momentum.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When price reaches ≤ 8EMA while VWAP > price (pullback to the ribbon) AND the subsequent bar closes above VWAP with RSI(14) > 50, enter long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the most recent swing low prior to entry (or a break below 8EMA). Initial target at 2 R. Runner trailed at 20 % from the highest close after TP1 is hit.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when 8‑EMA slope is upward ( ribbon sloping up ) and VIX between 12‑25. Avoid flat ribbon (slope ≈0) or VIX <10.

Blow-up scenario: volatility expansion (VIX>35) causing gap-through stops on news events.
